items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Jimmy has played trombone with Duke Ellington... (from the biographical note about the interviewee, Jimmy Cheatham)

ctx.x: Everything became one. And there’s all this diverse expression coming out of these horns. And from one section to the next, speaking to each other. Then in terms of mass unisons and you know, whatever, and solos, personal expression. And that whole band, just like when you hear Basie, it speaks.
And it was different when he was with Duke.
